name: io.github.ihen404/x402-scraper-client

tools.name: scrape_url
tools.description: Scrapes raw web page HTML, title, headings, and clean body text preview given a target URL. Handles on-chain 0.005 USDC auto-settlement on Base via x402 protocol.

url.description: The HTTP/HTTPS URL of the web page to scrape.
